_comment: The poison bog's area effect in Sorrowfen (content-zone-7-swamp.md C1): miasma damage over time to whatever stands in a Bog polygon, refreshed while you stay. Miasma is dealt by nothing else, so the swamp's mobs resist it at 0 and no player build loses anything. Stacking and the slow are owed (E1: an area applies dot_aura and hot_aura only). All values [PLACEHOLDER].
name: BogSickness
